description: Represents an exclusive work lease issued by canopy to a single agent for a bounded task. Prevents duplicate agents from claiming the same work unit.

lease_id.description: Unique identifier for this lease instance.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent holding this lease.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task this lease covers.

issued_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the lease was issued.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the lease expires and may be reclaimed.
